findings.description: intelligenceCycleJob step E hardcodes cooldownMinutes: 60 and maxAlertsPerStockPerDay: 3, both differ from mcp.config.json alertQuality (cooldownMinutes: 30, maxAlertsPerStockPerDay: 3) and from alertCooldown.ts DEFAULT_CONFIG (cooldownMinutes: 30, maxAlertsPerStockPerDay: 5)
findings.detail: Line 805: hardcoded { cooldownMinutes: 60, maxAlertsPerStockPerDay: 3 } passed to shouldSuppressAlert. Config specifies cooldownMinutes: 30 and (implicitly) maxAlertsPerStockPerDay: 5 as default. THREE DIFFERENT VALUES across system means prod behavior drifts from config and domain defaults. Comment indicates 60 is intentional for step E but should be config-driven.

findings.description: mcp.config.json market.referenceStocks duplicates sector classification data from SECTOR_PEERS (sectorPeers.ts). Both encode the same ticker-to-sector mapping.
findings.detail: Lines 58-77: referenceStocks is a flat Record<sector, ticker[]> that mirrors the SECTOR_PEERS structure. Used only in server.ts line 711-712 to build refCodes for the /api/watchlist endpoint. SECTOR_PEERS is the authoritative source; referenceStocks must stay in sync manually. Risk: sector changes made in SECTOR_PEERS forgotten in mcp.config.json, causing API divergence.
